newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end firmer on weak turnover.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end firmer on weak turnover.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed a shade firmer on Wednesday as short-term buying by local investors helped the market hold steady amid a sharp decline on Wall Street, traders said.
The bolsa is seen moving sideways again in slack trading, with the tight liquidity holding back the market's momentum, they said.
The 40-share .IPSA index ended unofficially 0.06 percent higher at 136.29 points. The general .IGPA index slipped 0.06 percent to 5,832.65 points.
